title: Home Delivery Pharmacy and Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit: Retail Bridge Allowance on a Missed Delivery
content:
## Cross-benefit coordination note: bridging supply at retail

**Rule.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy missed-delivery credit, a retail bridge allowance is added for a supply of the same drug bought at a retail pharmacy while the replacement was on its way, counted as paid retail claims for the replaced drug dated less than two whole months before the handling date: 15.00 for two or more such claims, 7.50 for exactly one, and nothing for none.

The claims read are the member's paid claims under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit: each claim's status (paid), drug name and date of service. The replaced drug is the drug on the home delivery replacement shipment. The allowance is added to the credit.

### Allowance by paid retail claims

| Paid retail claims for the replaced drug, dated less than two whole months before the handling date | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 15.00 |
| exactly 1 | 7.50 |
| none | nothing |

### Hypothetical cases

- The member filled the replaced drug twice at a network pharmacy in the last month, both claims paid: 15.00.
- One paid retail claim for the replaced drug and one for a different drug: 7.50, since only the replaced drug counts.
- A paid retail claim for the replaced drug dated three months before the handling date: outside the two-month span, nothing.
